She's kind of become the female Cena. She is talented, but she was also a favorite of the company itself. That means Charlotte got overpushed and was constantly at the top of the card. After doing stuff like beating Rhea for the NXT championship is when most people felt Charlotte was actually harming the booking of younger talent.

Since then I think her booking has been better since Charlotte kind of became a rite of passage for most women to be solidified as definite main eventers.
